name: Fibonacci Sequence
description: Generates the Fibonacci sequence where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones: 0,1,1,2,3,5,8,13,...
aim: Compute the nth Fibonacci number iteratively or recursively, demonstrating the difference between O(n) DP and O(2^n) naive recursion.
howItWorks: Iterative: use two variables a,b; update a=b, b=a+b

complexity.spaceDescription: Iterative with two variables; O(n) for array version

whenToUse: Sequence generation problems with simple recurrence
alternatives: Binet's formula — O(1) but floating point precision issues
